decisions.evidence: The pre-reader proof omitted measurable increment suprema, a measurable conull set, and the finite-integral-implies-finite-a.e. step. The reader repair supplies these. Alpha retains it, explicitly defines norm and distance using zero extensions from common conull continuity sets on possibly incomplete label spaces, proves representative independence and definiteness, and corrects the product-measurability reference to F6. All four steps and eleven prerequisites reviewed; both direct fixed-point consumers use the same quotient and need no source repair.

The reader makes M an integer at least one, the exact domain required for the Euclidean cube and W1 supplier. Unsampled vertices have mass at least 1-N/2^M and distance at least one to sample support, including repeated samples; N>=2^M gives a valid nonpositive lower bound. Taking 2^M>=2N excludes a uniform dimension-free C/sqrt(N). The original argument is retained; only the owning B summary references this example and requires no repair.

The observed Definition asserted finite evaluations/sums without a separate proved property result. This is nonfatal because finite loops make the proof immediate. Alpha moved termination into the existing thm-tensor-simpson-force-error, proving invalid-input returns, first oracle failure, and finite sums on a finite grid. On smooth valid input the exact query count is (nx+1)(ny+1). The algorithm now points to this theorem through justified_by. Its procedure, values and statuses are unchanged; its only item/reference consumer is that theorem.

The opening literal pull-toward-mean assertion included a=0. With N=2 and initial positions 0,2, x_i(t)=mean+exp(-at)(x_i(0)-mean) stays at 0,2 and neither particle moves toward mean 1. Alpha distinguishes a>0 attraction from a=0 stationary trajectories in the Example and verification, preserving a>=0 and the exact formula. All four cited suppliers reviewed; the sole referencing B page receives the corresponding surgical correction.

The page claimed every particle approaches the mean while its linked example allows a=0. The explicit two-particle stationary counterexample confirms the original literal defect. The summary now limits exponential approach to a>0 and explicitly states the a=0 stationary case. The full current linked example and its exact dependencies were reviewed; the corrected page accurately preserves both cases.

The pre-reader compact-tube wording did not state the open time-state domain and convexity required by the RK4 supplier. The reader supplies them while retaining bounded C4 derivatives and stages from both exact/numerical starts. Independently checked all four steps and thirteen prerequisites: zero M is trivial; matching Jordan masses and consolidation give sum|Gamma|=M; signed force defects yield the stated exponential estimate and blockwise RK4 displacement adds M*C_RK*h^4. Only its owning A summary references this result and already states the conditional bounds.

The pre-reader quadrature residual lacked a specified rectangle, even panel counts and derivative bounds, and the RK4 tube lacked open-domain/convexity hypotheses. The reader supplies all exact supplier premises and the eta_q formula, preserving the claimed bound. Both verification steps and nine prerequisites reviewed. A near-optimal initial probability coupling is labelled by distinct particle nodes, then its cost increases by at most C_RK*h^4 under numerical replacement; letting delta tend to zero is choice-free. The sole referencing B summary already carries all needed caveats.
